All creatures of your choice in the sphere have their jump distance doubled and their speed increased by 10 feet. They also have advantage on Acrobatics checks and ignore falling damage if they end their fall within the sphere.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 193 (Indie)

fields.name: Displacing Maw (HB)
fields.classes: Paladin (Oath of the Eldritch Hunt (HB)), School: Conjuration, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
Your rib cage opens up violently, forming a maw that attempts to devour a creature within range. The creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes 4d8 piercing damage and is transported through magic to a point of your choice on the ground within 60 feet of you, where the maw reappears and regurgitates them. On a success, it takes half as much damage and is not transported.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8, and the teleportation range increases by 10 feet, for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 194 (Indie)

fields.name: Malicious Rancor (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a skull that belonged to a creature that succumbed to a curse, worth at least 1 sp, which the spell consumes)
fields.text:
You hurl a deformed skull covered in scratches and holes and strewn in curses at a creature within range, where the skull explodes with violent hatred. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 necrotic damage. Hit or miss, the skull then detonates, emitting a psychic wailing from that point. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 5d4 psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the start of your next turn, if a creature enters the area or ends its turn there, it must make the saving throw against the skull's damage.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the psychic damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 194 (Indie)

fields.name: Osseous Cage (HB)
fields.classes: Druid (Circle of Symbiosis (HB)), School: Conjuration, Druid, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You cause a cage of cartilage and bones to erupt from the ground that surrounds a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The bones are thick and provide three-quarters cover to creatures inside and outside. When you or any other creature attempts to pass through the cage, you can use your reaction to let them through. Large or Larger creatures cannot enter the cage, and are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space if they are within the cage's area when it first appears. The osseous cage has AC 12, 100 hit points, and vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. If you cast this spell again while you already have a cage summoned, the previous cage turns to dust.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the cage has an additional 20 hit points for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 194 (Indie)

fields.name: Osseous Impalement (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a calcified bamboo stick)
fields.text:
Massive bone spikes sprout under up to four creatures on the ground of your choice you can see within range. They must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d10 piercing damage and be impaled by the spike, becoming restrained and held aloft 5 feet in the air for the duration. A creature restrained in this way takes 1d10 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to make an Athletics check contested by your spell save DC, breaking the bone spike and freeing itself on a success.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage (both initial and ongoing) increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 194 (Indie)

fields.name: Radiant Bell (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a silvered choir bell* worth at least 5 gp, which the spell consumes)
fields.text:
You ring an arcane, silver bell, imbuing it with healing magics that cure the afflicted. Choose any number of creatures within 30 feet. For each target, you can end one of the following conditions: charmed, frightened, poisoned, petrified, or stunned. This cure does not work if a target is deafened.

*It is rumored that the soft ringing carries its energies across planes.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 195 (Indie)

fields.name: Radiant Slaughter (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (the petrified fetus of a Great One)
fields.text:
You summon a small nova of eldritch power in this secret technique from the Obitus Scholare. Each creature within 30 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 2d6 force damage, 3d6 radiant damage, and is knocked prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. Creatures within 5 feet of you make this saving throw with disadvantage.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the force and radiant damage both increase by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 195 (Indie)

fields.name: Rubber Bones (HB)
fields.classes: School: Transmutation, Touch Spells, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You touch a willing creature. Its bones become soft and rubbery, and it gains the following benefits:

	• It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape a grapple without requiring an ability check and can squeeze through a space that is large enough for a creature two sizes smaller than it.

	• It has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

	• It has resistance to bludgeoning damage.

	• Its reach with melee attacks increases by 5 feet.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 195 (Indie)

fields.name: Spectral Fury (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp)
fields.classes: Paladin (Oath of the Eldritch Hunt (HB)), School: Conjuration, Paladin, Ranger
fields.text:
You send forth three spectral duplicates of yourself to strike down enemies within 30 feet of you. You can order them to strike one target or several. Make a melee spell attack for each spectral duplicate. On a hit, a target takes 4d8 damage of your weapon's damage type.
	You can then use a bonus action to move up to 30 feet in a straight line towards one of the targets without provoking opportunity attacks, streaking through a spectral trail, and make a single melee weapon attack.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage your spectral duplicates inflict increases by 2d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 195 (Indie)

fields.name: Dread Scarecrow (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a flute made of a femur worth 50 gp)
fields.text:
You magically create the horrifying illusion of all your bones breaking and your body bending in impossible ways, accompanied by the sound of a shattered skull. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for the duration. While frightened by this spell, a creature's speed becomes 0 and it falls prone, its legs giving out under the fear. If an affected creature takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 196 (Indie)

fields.name: Fling (HB)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Touch Spells, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You flick your finger against a creature. The target is impacted by a devastating gravitational force and must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 120 feet away from you. The push stops early if the creature hits a solid surface or is pushed into a creature of its size or larger. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
	If the target is pushed into or through the space of a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This damage is increased by 1d10 per size smaller the creature is than the target.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the target takes an extra 1d10 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 30 additional feet for each slot level above 4th.

Note: For example, if a commoner (size Medium) is pushed into a frog (size Tiny), the frog must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. Because the frog is 2 sizes smaller than the commoner, on a failed save, it would take 3d10 damage (the original 1d10 damage, which is increased by 2d10), probably exploding on impact, whilst the commoner would continue its destructive flight unhindered-questioning the laws of physics.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 196 (Indie)

fields.name: Graveyard Shuffle (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a piece of spinal bone and an opal worth at least 300 gold, which the spell consumes)
fields.text:
You drain the bone marrow of a creature, attempting to steal its life force and transfer it to another creature of your choice. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 necrotic damage. Choose another creature within range; it regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt, or if it was dead for less than 1 minute, the creature returns to life with hit points equal to the number regained. If any of the targets do not have bones, the spell fails. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 196 (Indie)

fields.name: Gravitational Distortion (HB)
fields.text:
Reality swirls in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within range. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw, taking 6d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, any creature that fails this saving throw is pushed 30 feet in a straight line in a direction of your choice.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 197 (Indie)

fields.name: Gravity Barrier (HB)
fields.text:
You create a wall of increased gravity on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall lasts for the duration and its space is difficult terrain.
	Ranged weapon attacks that pass through the wall's space automatically fail, and other ranged attacks have disadvantage. Any creature that tries to pass through the wall's space must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 4d8 bludgeoning damage, be knocked prone, and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its turn.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 197 (Indie)

fields.name: Jumping Jolt (HB)
fields.text:
You release an arc of lighting at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature. On a hit, the target takes 4d12 lightning damage, and you can cause the spell to repeatedly jump to another target within 20 feet of the previous target, making a separate attack roll for each target. The spell cannot hit the same target twice, or jump to a target out of the spell's range. The spell can jump a maximum of five times. On a miss, the target takes half as much damage and the spell does not jump to a new target.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d12 for each slot level above 4th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 197 (Indie)

fields.name: Maiden of Bones (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a virgin's carpal bone)
fields.classes: Druid (Circle of Symbiosis (HB)), Paladin (Oath of the Eldritch Hunt (HB)), School: Conjuration, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
A creature within range must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be trapped inside an iron maiden formed of bone that appears in its space. The creature is considered restrained, incapacitated, behind total cover, can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, and takes 3d6 piercing damage at the start of each of its turns as spikes of bone pierce its body. At the end of each of its turns, a trapped creature can repeat the saving throw, escaping and ending the spell on a success. The bone maiden has AC 14, 80 hit points, immunity to psychic and poison damage, and vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. If the maiden is destroyed, the creature trapped inside is freed and the spell ends.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 198 (Indie)

fields.name: Vanishing Step (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (the bone of an old hunter)
fields.text:
For the duration, once on each of your turns, you can use 15 feet of your movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. This fails if you are prone or incapacitated.
	In addition, when you are hit by an attack or targeted by a spell, you can use your reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you, causing the attack to miss you or the spell to not affect you if you leave its range or radius. When you do so, until the end of your next turn, your speed is reduced by 15 feet.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 198 (Indie)

fields.name: World Breaker (HB)
fields.text:
You destroy your surroundings to break your foes. You rip a 5-foot by 5-foot cube of nonmagical terrain from the ground and hurl it at a point you can see within range, where it shatters in a 30-foot cone extending away from you. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d8 bludgeoning damage and be pushed 15 feet in a straight line away from you.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 198 (Indie)

fields.name: Ancestral Bond (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (the bone of a humanoid, which the spell may consume)
fields.classes: School: Divination, Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You touch the corpse of a humanoid, and visions of its descendants come to you, as ephemeral spirits scour the world. You learn how many living relatives the humanoid left behind and if they have any living descendants.
	In addition, you can select one of the descendants whose existence you can feel through the spell. By destroying the corpse to amplify the power of the magic, you can attempt to determine their location. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you learn their exact location, no matter where they are.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 198 (Indie)

fields.name: Chisel Skull (HB)
fields.components: S, M (a piece of skull bone)
fields.text:
Choose a creature you can see within range. You cause its skull to snap, piercing its insides. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 8d10 piercing damage and is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't paralyzed. A creature without a skull is immune to this spell.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 198 (Indie)

fields.name: Divine Order Reveal (HB)
fields.text:
You attempt to gaze upon the soul of a creature within range. It must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, its origins are revealed to you, and you learn all of the creature's ability scores, skill proficiencies, damage vulnerabilities, damage resistances, damage immunities, condition immunities, saving throw proficiencies, weapon and armor proficiencies, alignment, and traits.
	If a creature succeeds on this saving throw, it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours.

GM Note: This is the equivalent of revealing the upper part (above the actions) of a stat block to your player.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 199 (Indie)

fields.name: Forest of Dread (HB)
fields.classes: Druid (Circle of Symbiosis (HB)), School: Conjuration, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You touch the ground under you and 20-foot-tall treelike bones sprout from the ground in a 30-foot radius centered on you. Each creature of your choice in the radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 piercing damage on a failure, or half as much damage a success.
	For the duration, the area becomes difficult terrain, and when a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d8 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels; you are immune to this effect. The forest of dread provides half cover to any creatures inside the area. The bones disintegrate when the spell ends.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 199 (Indie)

fields.name: Starfall (HB)
fields.classes: Warlock (The Void (HB)), School: Enchantment, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard
fields.text:
You create a violent star shower. When you cast this spell and as a bonus action on your subsequent turns, you can bring down stars on creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you. Each creature struck by a star takes 1d10+1 radiant damage.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Erupting Lightning (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (the vertebrae of a Lightning Vessel barbarian)
fields.text:
You slam the ground with the palm of your hand, causing pillars of lightning to erupt from the ground beneath your foes. The area of lightning consists of up to seven 5-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d10 lightning damage and falls prone on a failed save, or half as much damage and doesn't fall prone on a successful one.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can generate two additional 5-foot cubes of lightning for each slot level above 6th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Unbound Chamber (HB)
fields.classes: School: Transmutation, Ritual Caster, Druid, Sorcerer, Wizard
fields.text:
Using a ritual of ancient magic, you distort the gravitational balance of an enclosed space of your choice for the duration. The chamber can be of any shape up to 200 feet wide, 200 feet tall, and 200 feet long. While in the chamber, a creature doesn't take falling damage, has its jump distance tripled, has a flying speed equal to its walking speed, and can hover.
	Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Void Walk (HB)
fields.classes: School: Transmutation, Touch Spells, Bard, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, it gains a flying speed equal to its walking speed and can hover.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 6th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Wall of Bones (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a calcified egg shell)
fields.classes: School: Necromancy, Cleric, Sorcerer, Wizard, School: Conjuration, Warlock
fields.text:
A grim wall of fractured bones appears at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose: horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. It must rest on a solid surface. The wall can be up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight, and creatures can't pass through it. The wall is an object, and has AC 15, 150 hit points, immunity to poison and psychic damage, and vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. Reducing it to 0 hit points destroys it.
	When the wall appears, each creature in its space is pushed out of it by the shortest route and must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.
	Until the spell ends, and as long as the wall has sufficient hit points, you can use an action to sacrifice 20 hit points from the wall to summon a minotaur skeleton that has murderous killing intent. The creature appears in an unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to the wall. When you summon a minotaur skeleton in this way, designate a creature you can see within 60 feet of it; that creature becomes the sole enemy of the summoned creature. The minotaur skeleton ignores any orders you give, tries to kill its target by any means, and is immune to being charmed. Once its target is dead, it vanishes in a pile of dust.
	You can have a maximum of three creatures summoned by this spell at a time.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Amputate (HB)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Touch Spells, Druid, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You coat your hand with vicious osteomancy. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, you deal 10d8 slashing damage. In addition, you rip off one of the creature's limbs (leg, arm, or other similar appendage). A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its limbs to be cut off with this spell. Such a creature takes an extra 5d8 slashing damage instead.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the initial damage increases by 4d8, and the alternative damage by 2d8, for each slot level above 7th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Boneyard (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (enchanted bones, incense, and herbs worth at least 1000 gold, which the spell consumes)
fields.classes: School: Necromancy, Touch Spells, Cleric, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
You touch a point and infuse an area around it with osteomancy. The area can have a radius of up to 120 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect of a boneyard or hallow spell. The affected area is subject to the following effects.
	First, you know the exact location and hear the thoughts (if any) of any undead creature within the area, and you know if they are under someone's control.
	Second, all creatures within the area lose resistance and immunity to necrotic and piercing damage.
	Finally, as a reaction whenever a non-undead creature dies within the area, you can choose to rip its skeleton from its flesh and force it to rise again under your control. If you do, the creature is resurrected with 1 hit point, its creature type becomes undead, it becomes immune to all damage, it loses access to any legendary actions it had (if any), and you can mentally command its actions. At the end of its next turn, it dies and cannot be resurrected by any means short of a wish spell.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Crush (HB)
fields.text:
You attempt to trap one creature you can see within range in a field of gravity that compresses and folds in on itself. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 12d10 bludgeoning damage and be stunned until the start of your next turn as it reels from the pain.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 7th.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Divine Order Transcend (HB)
fields.text:
You call upon the power of the Great Ones, seeking their guidance. Until the spell ends, you gain the ability to cast any spell from the warlock spell list of 5th level or lower without expending a spell slot or needing to prepare the spell. As part of casting this spell, you can cast a spell with a casting time of an action from your newfound spell list. However, the cost of using this power is steep. At the end of each of your turns, you must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw or take 2d10 psychic damage. If you fail this saving throw two times, the spell ends early and you gain a short-term madness.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, it no longer requires concentration, though you can choose to end the spell whenever.

Short-Term Madness:
When a character is afflicted with short-term madness, roll a d100 on the table below, then roll a d10 to determine the effect of that form of madness. All effects are for the duration of the madness unless specified otherwise.

Short-Term Madness table:

1-10 - Your mind is liberated from any sense of self you may possess:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Without an ego, you are immune to the charmed condition.
3-8 | You mimic the mannerisms, behavior, and speech patterns of the creature closest to you when you gained this madness.
8-10 | Desperate to find yourself again and believing anything, you automatically fail saving throws against being charmed.

11-20 - Your mind is invaded by the sound of the cosmos:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Painful sounds pale in comparison to the cacophony in your head; you are immune to thunder damage.
3-8 | Eldritch utterings scratch your brain; you hear the soft caress of whispers behind your back.
8-10 | The sound of the cosmos drowns out all other noise, closing you to the world. You are deafened and have disadvantage on saving throws made to maintain your concentration.

21-30 - You have seen too much; your mind can't understand it, causing your sight to become erratic and unreliable:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Your vision expands as if you are under the effect of the see invisibility spell.
3-8 | Spectral forms flitter at the corners of your eyes, vanishing when you turn your head.
8-10 | You are blinded, and you can't use any special senses you use to see, such as blindsight or tremorsense.

31-40 - The madness inside you bursts forth as haunting screams:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Your scream is so loud that it can cause damage. As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can scream at a creature you see within 30 feet of you. If the target can hear you, it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 1d12 thunder damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success.
3-8 | You can't talk properly; yelling is the only way you can communicate.
8-10 | Your screams are so overwhelming that any creature within 300 feet of you can hear you talk. You also can't form coherent sentences or utter the vocal components of spells.

41-50 - Your posture crumples, as you try to make sense of the insanity before you:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | You become incredibly skittish. When you are the target of an attack or an effect that requires you to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to begin moving evasively, gaining a +1 bonus to AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws until the start of your next turn.
3-8 | You desperately look for a parental figure that can protect you. Once you find such a person, you latch on to them and refuse to leave their side, no matter what.
8-10 | You fall prone and can't stand, as your legs refuse to obey you, and you can't use any flying speed you possess.

51-60 - You realize that your hands are blasphemous tools:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | These tools can break the minds of your foes. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage to it.
3-8 | You refuse to use your hands for anything, keeping them hidden from view. If someone stares at them, it makes you extremely uncomfortable and defensive.
8-10 | You shouldn't touch anything. You drop anything you are holding, and can't hold items or grapple creatures.

61-70 - Your body breaks down under the insanity:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | You are immune to the poisoned condition.
3-8 | You start emitting a foul smell that is unpleasant even to you, and no amount of washing or magic can remove it.
8-10 | You are poisoned, even if you are immune to the condition.

71-80 - The Eldritch Horrors are revealed to you, bathing you in fear:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | When you gain this madness, each creature within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
3-8 | You become paranoid and fearful of any movement or sound.
8-10 | You become frightened of your allies. You must take the Dash action and move away from them by the quickest available route on each of your turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If you start your turn in a location where you can't see any of your allies, you can use your action to end the madness.

81-90 - The madness breaks your mind:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | You realize your mind has been holding back your body, and you can now act freely. You have an additional action on each of your turns. That action can be used only to take the Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.
3-8 | You burst into spontaneous fits of laughter randomly, even at the most inappropriate times.
8-10 | You are incapacitated. This effect ends early if you take damage equal to twice your level or if a greater restoration spell is cast on you.

91-95 - The revelations from beyond afflict you:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Your body ignores all pain; only the Eldritch Truth matters. You are immune to the stunned condition.
3-8 | You speak to others of the Eldritch Truth in a way that seems limpid to you, but is perhaps not so clear to others. Your sentences are cryptic for the unascended mind.
8-10 | You are stunned. This effect ends early if you take damage equal to your level or if a greater restoration spell is cast on you.

96-100 - The beast within you awakens and attempts to take control:
d10 | Short-Term Madness
1-2 | Your body releases its animalistic instincts, without the influence of your mind to restrain it. You are under the effect of the haste spell, although it doesn't require concentration. The spell ends when the madness does.
3-8 | Your speech is slurred, as if you're intoxicated, and you punctuate your sentences with animal noises.
8-10 | You fall unconscious, your mind fighting its hardest to not let you become a beast. This effect ends early if you take damage equal to your level or if a greater restoration spell is cast on you.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Bury (HB)
fields.text:
You dramatically increase the pull of gravity in a 30-footradius, 300-foot-high cylinder centered on a point on the ground within range. Creatures in this area are knocked prone and cannot lose this condition while there. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is knocked prone and takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage. A flying creature in the area immediately falls to the ground and is knocked prone. A creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw to move or perform any action. Each foot of movement while in the area costs a creature 3 extra feet.
	A prone creature that ends its turn in the cylinder must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be forced into the ground as gravity pulls it down. It is restrained and incapacitated by the crushing pressure and the ground around it, but it gains the benefits of three-quarters cover, as only the upper part of their body is visible. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself from the ground on a success.
	If the spell lasts for its full duration, the ground cracks under the tremendous weight generated and becomes difficult terrain. Each 5-foot-square area requires at least 1 minute to clear by hand to remove the difficult terrain.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Aspect of Death (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (the skull of a fallen hero, embedded with jewels worth at least 4,000 gp)
fields.text:
You focus threads of magical energy around you which coalesce into the aspect of death, an avatar made of bones, which surrounds you and fights on your behalf.
	The avatar is Large, is centered on you, and moves with you. While it is summoned, it protects you from foes;
you are considered behind three-quarters cover at all times, have resistance to all damage, are immune to being grappled, and no other creature can enter the space of the avatar.
	In addition, while active, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and saving throws, and when you cast a spell that deals bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, it is cast with a spell slot 2 levels higher than the one expended (to a maximum of 9th level).

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Divine Order Sacrifice (HB)
fields.text:
When you cast this spell, you create a crack in the world, letting the will of a Great One smother a creature of your choice within range. The direct contact with the eldritch being causes the target to take 8d6 psychic damage, and it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is pulled in through the tear to the cosmos. On a success, it isn't pulled but gains a long-term madness, and the spell ends.
	While in the cosmos, the target is incapacitated. At the beginning of each of its turns while there, it takes 3d6 cold damage, 3d6 psychic damage, and must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or gain a short-term madness.
	When the spell ends, if the target is still alive, it reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied. If the creature is killed while in the void, its corpse never returns. A body that disappears in this way can never be recovered, not even with a wish spell.
	If your concentration on the spell ends early, you must succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence saving throw or gain a long-term madness as the eldritch whispers revolt and assault your mind.
	When the spell ends, roll a d100. On a 1, the breach doesn't close and instead only expands, threatening to absorb the entire world.

3-8 | Your speech is slurred, as if you're intoxicated, and you punctuate your sentences with animal noises.
8-10 | You fall unconscious, your mind fighting its hardest to not let you become a beast. This effect ends early if you take damage equal to your level or if a greater restoration spell is cast on you.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Osteophagia (HB)
fields.classes: School: Conjuration, Touch Spells, Warlock, Wizard
fields.text:
The most lethal osteomantic power. You can cause the skeleton of a creature to liquefy in a matter of seconds, causing the body to collapse in on itself. Choose a creature within your reach; it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or die.
	A successful save prevents the death by skeletal collapse, but the creature still takes 10d6 necrotic damage. Creatures without bones and creatures whose CR or character level is equal to or higher than the caster's CR or character level are immune to this spell.

Source:	Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt p. 200 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Death Grip (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

You may use your bonus action and spend 1 Soul Point to conjure a hand of necrotic energy that reaches for a creature within 30 feet of you. This creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled to the nearest empty space close to you, provided that the path is clear.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Death Protection (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

When a creature's attack hits you or an ally within 5 feet of you, you may take a reaction and spend 1 Soul Point to give an AC bonus to the target hit by the attack equal to your proficiency bonus against this attack.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Death Strike (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you may spend 1 Soul Point to cause an extra 1d10 of necrotic damage to the creature. At 11th level, you may spend 2 Soul Points to cause an extra 2d10 of necrotic damage. You may only use this ability once per turn.
	If a creature dies in the same turn you hit it with a Death Strike, you gain 1d6 temporary hit points, but you can't gain any Soul Point from that death.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Death Terror (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

You may use your bonus action and spend 1 Soul Point to attempt to frighten a creature that is adjacent to you. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature may make a saving throw to try to end the frightened condition.

Frightened:
	• A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight.
	• The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Fleeing Death (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

When another creature deals damage to you with a melee attack, you may take a reaction and spend 1 Soul Point to reduce the damage by 1d10. At 7th level, you may spend additional Soul Points to further reduce the damage taken. For each extra Soul Point spent with this Death Power, you reduce an additional 1d10 of the damage taken.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Undying Knight (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

As an action and by spending 1 Soul Point, you can spend up to 3 Hit Dice to regain hit points.
	Additionally, you regain an extra amount of hit points equal to half your Constitution bonus (rounded up) for each Hit Die used.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Unwearying Warrior (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

When you would suffer a level of exhaustion, you can spend 1 Soul Point and not suffer it, regardless of its origin.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

name: Death Powers: Visions of the Afterlife (HB)

fields.name: Death Powers: Visions of the Afterlife (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 3rd Level

You can use a bonus action and spend 1 Soul Point to gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet until your next short or long rest. If you already have darkvision, this Death Power doubles its range. When activated, you can concentrate using a bonus action to gain a glimpse of what is occurring in the Ethereal Plane for the next 10 minutes. After this time, Vision of the Afterlife ends.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Ethereal Move (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 7th Level

You may use your bonus action and spend 1 Soul Point to automatically move 30 feet without spending your speed. During this movement, you move through the ethereal plane, so you do not provoke opportunity attacks, ignore difficult terrain, and can move through objects and creatures. You must end your movement in an unoccupied space, or be expelled to the nearest unoccupied space.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Strangling Grip (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 7th Level, Death Grip

When you declare the use of the Death Grip, you can use an action and spend an extra 1 Soul Point to impose the restrained condition on the target, in addition to the effects of Death Grip, if the target fails its saving throw. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Death Embrace (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 7th Level

When you suffer cold, lightning, or necrotic damage, you may take a reaction and spend 1 Soul Point to gain resistance against the triggering damage. At 12th level, you may spend an extra 1 Soul Point to gain immunity against the triggering damage, rather than just resistance

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Undead Fortitude (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 7th Level

When your hit points are reduced to 0 but you are not killed outright, you can spend 1 Soul Point and make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a success, you remain at 1 hit point. The DC increases by 2 for each subsequent use of this ability before a long rest.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Creeping Darkness (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 10th Level, Ethereal Move

When an ally within 60 feet of you suffers an attack, you may take a reaction and spend 1 Soul Point to teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to them and take the attack in their place, gaining resistance to the damage from this attack

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Grave Mist (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 10th Level

You may use your bonus action and spend 1 Soul Point to summon an eerie mist. You affect a circular area with a 10-foot radius centered on you for 1 minute. Any creature that enters or is within this area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for the next minute. If the creature is no longer in the affected area, it may make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to try to end the poisoned condition.

Poisoned:
	• A poisoned creature has disadvantage on Attack rolls and Ability Checks.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Life Drain (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 10th Level

You can use your action to attempt to touch a living creature adjacent to you. To determine if your touch is successful, you must make an unarmed strike against the creature. On a hit, you deal 1d10 necrotic damage for each Soul Point spent on this Death Power, and regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Death Powers: Terrifying Howl (HB)
fields.text:
Prerequisite: 10th Level

You can use your action and spend 1 Soul Point to unleash a haunting howl that mimics the sound of death. Creatures of your choice that can hear you and are within 60 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is frightened of you for the next minute. A frightened creature must use all its movement to move away from you. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 229 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Force Wave (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack. Even on a miss, a seismic ripple emanates from you, targeting a creature within 15 feet of you (which could be the same or a different target). This creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 thunder damage and be thrown off balance, landing prone.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Elemental Flay (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage and distress a substantial portion of the target's skin. The next time the creature takes damage before the end of your next turn, it suffers an extra 1d6 damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Ancestral Blessing (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal your usual damage and bask in a soft luminescence of sacred golden light that bestows upon you 1d6 temporary hit points for 1 minute.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Draconic Shield (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack. Then, choose either yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of you, and generate an unseen protection barrier. The beneficiary gains a +2 bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on all saving throws until the start of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Distracting Tail (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage and destabilize the enemy, causing it to lose the ability to make Opportunity Attacks and suffer a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dashing Rush (HB)
fields.text:
Move up to half your base speed, ignoring difficult terrain, and make a weapon attack. If at least 10 feet of this movement is completed in a straight line, your attack deals 1d6 extra damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 68 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Burning Strike (HB)
fields.text:
Infuse your weapon with dragon fire and make a weapon attack. On a hit, the target takes the usual damage plus an extra 1d6 fire damage. The extra fire damage increases to 2d6 at 7th level, 3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 13th level, 5d6 at 16th level, and 6d6 at 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Shield of Scales (HB)
fields.text:
Choose either yourself or a creature within 5 feet of you. An icy barrier springs up as a shield against attacks until the end of your next turn. The creature under protection receives an AC bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier against the next attack.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Lightning Dash (HB)
fields.text:
You effortlessly move at your speed, ignoring difficult terrain, and without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, if you move within 5 feet of any number of creatures, each one takes 1d6 lightning damage, only once per use of this power.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Inspiring Roar (HB)
fields.text:
Your dragon-heartened courage motivates either yourself or an ally. A willing creature of your choice within 15 feet of you gets a +1d6 bonus on its next attack roll. Additionally, any frightened condition on that creature is immediately removed.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Elemental Weapon (HB)
fields.text:
Your weapon erupts with elemental energy. Make a weapon attack and, on a hit, deal the usual damage plus an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as your Draconic Soul. If your attack misses, the target takes 1d6 damage of the same type.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Spiritual Fog (HB)
fields.text:
A visibly magical fog billows from your breath, covering a 15-foot-radius sphere around you. It remains stagnant until the start of your next turn, providing half-cover to all creatures enveloped by it. A moderate or greater wind speed (at least 10 mph) instantly disperses the fog.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dragon's Vitality (HB)
fields.text:
You invigorate an ally with dragon-like vitality. A willing creature you can see within 15 feet of you can take its reaction to spend up to half. of its available Hit Dice to regain hit points. Additionally, if at least 1 Hit Dice is spent, it gains temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier for 1 minute.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Wings of Wind (HB)
fields.text:
Make a weapon attack that summons a gust of wind in its wake. After the attack (even if it misses), the wind shields you and another willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you, granting both of you a +1 AC bonus until your next turn. In addition, if that creature becomes a target, you can use a reaction to swap positions and become the target instead.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

name: Draconic Power: Bind of the Wavering (HB)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Bind of the Wavering (HB)
fields.text:
Your supernaturally quick movement leaves your enemy's defense open. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage, and the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, an ally within 15 feet of the target may take a reaction to move up to 10 feet and make an opportunity attack against it.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Sundering Strike (HB)
fields.text:
Your weapon lands a precise hit, rending the target's defenses. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, you deal the usual damage and leave the target vulnerable, granting advantage to the first attack roll of each creature that attacks the target until the end of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Enduring Scales (HB)
fields.text:
You imbue the target's skin with mystical draconic scales, providing additional fortification. You or a willing creature within 30 feet of you gains 1d12 temporary hit points for the next minute. This increases to 2d12 at 10th level and 3d12 at 16th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 69 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Tail Slam (HB)
fields.text:
Swing your weapon with a mighty force to push your enemy away. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage and, if the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 1d10 bludgeoning damage and be pushed 20 feet from you in a straight line. If another creature obstructs the path, the movement halts, and that creature takes the same 1d10 bludgeoning damage.
	The distance increases to 30 feet and damage to 2d10 at 10th level, then further to 40 feet and 3d10 at 16th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Spiritual Retribution (HB)
fields.text:
Curse those who attack your comrades while in your vicinity. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or bear your draconic energy curse until the end of your next turn.
	If the cursed target is within 20 feet of you and strikes a creature other than you, it takes damage equal to half the damage dealt to the other creature. The damage matches the type of your Draconic Soul.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Destructive Claws (HB)
fields.text:
Imbue your weapon with draconic elemental powers for a forceful strike. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage and an extra 2d12 of one of these types at your choice: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, or Poison.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

roll.@_description: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid or Poison Damage

fields.name: Draconic Power: Draconic Challenge (HB)
fields.text:
Compel your adversaries to focus their attacks on you. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal its damage, and until the end of your next turn, the target is compelled to attack you. Gain a +2 bonus to your AC against the target, and if the target is within 30 feet of you and targets another creature with an attack or offensive spell, it takes 4d8 psychic damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Martyr's Shield (HB)
fields.text:
Forfeit your defense to shield your comrades. Until the start of your next turn, you suffer a -2 penalty to your AC, and all willing creatures you choose within 30 feet of you gain a +4 bonus to their AC.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dive Attack (HB)
fields.text:
You leap over a distance up to your walking speed, clearing obstacles on the way up to 20 feet high, and you must land in an unoccupied space. Every creature within 10 feet of your landing space must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d6 bludgeoning damage (half damage on a successful save).

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Static Imprisonment (HB)
fields.text:
Infuse your weapon with static energy to impair your foe's movements. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage, and the targeted creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d10 lightning damage and reduce 10 feet of all movement speeds for 1 minute.
	During this minute, the target is charged with static energy, and whenever you hit it with your weapon attack, it loses an extra 10 feet of its speed and takes an extra 1d10 lightning damage (with no saving throw). If its speed becomes zero, the creature takes a final extra 2d10 lightning damage, and this effect ends.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Ring of Fire (HB)
fields.text:
Engulf your weapon in flames and attack every creature within your vicinity in a flaming spin attack. All creatures within 15 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d12 fire damage (half damage on a success).
	The damage increases to 4d12 at 13th level and 6d12 at 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Frozen Spikes (HB)
fields.text:
Infuse your weapon with chilling cold that permeates the area around you. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, you deal the usual damage and create an aura with a 15-foot radius around you, lasting until the end of your next turn. All creatures of your choice within the aura, or those entering it for the first time, must make a Constitution saving throw. Failure results in them taking 3d8 cold damage, while a success halves the damage. The area is considered difficult terrain for all creatures except you.
	Upon reaching the 16th level, the damage increases to 5d8.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 70 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Binding Lightning (HB)
fields.text:
Unleash a bolt of lightning that energizes and hinders enemy movement. Make a ranged spell attack against a visible target creature within 60 feet of you. On a hit, the creature takes 3d10 lightning damage and becomes electrically charged, taking 1d6 lightning damage for every 5 feet of willing movement until the end of its next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 71 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dragon Mark (HB)
fields.text:
You designate an adversary as your primary foe. Target a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become marked. The mark lasts for 1 minute or until you mark another creature or the marked creature becomes unconscious or dies. The marked creature takes 1d10 damage of the type defined by your Draconic Soul and a -1 penalty to AC each time it attacks a creature other than you.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 71 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Elemental Cyclone (HB)
fields.text:
Create a potent cyclone of energy, stretching 10 feet wide and reaching 15 feet high, that travels a straight 30-foot path. Every creature in its trajectory makes a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes 4d10 damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The type of damage matches your selected Draconic Soul.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Arcane Barrier (HB)
fields.text:
By inscribing a protective rune, you form a protective barrier over yourself or an ally with your draconic energy. You or a willing creature within 30 feet of you gains resistance to damage from spells and is immune to spells of 4th level or lower, even if amplified with higher-level spell slots. If a spell is already affecting the target, its effects are temporarily suppressed. The power remains active until the end of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Hardened Scales (HB)
fields.text:
Bestow upon yourself or an ally the resilience of a dragon. Until your next turn ends, a willing creature within 20 feet of you gains resistance to non-magical slashing, piercing, and bludgeoning damage, along with an advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Linked Bolt (HB)
fields.text:
Electrify your foes with polar-opposite charges. Make a ranged spell attack on two distinct creatures within 60 feet of you. Each target struck takes 3d10 lightning damage and is pushed 10 feet towards the other. If both targets end up adjacent, they take an extra 3d10 lightning damage. The power requires two different targets to activate.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Stormbringer (HB)
fields.text:
Infuse your feet with energy, granting the ability to stride upon the winds. You gain a flight movement equivalent to your walking speed for this turn. On a hit, your next attack during this turn deals an additional 1d8 lightning damage for every 10 feet of straight-line flight movement made before the attack. If your turn ends in mid-air, you fall as usual.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Boon of Flames (HB)
fields.text:
Infuse your weapons with fiery energy. It deals an extra 4d6 fire damage to all attacks until the end of your next turn. The damage increases to 6d6 at the 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Frost Burst (HB)
fields.text:
Slam your weapon against the ground, triggering a frost energy explosion. All creatures within 10 feet of you must pass a Constitution saving throw. Those who fail take 3d8 cold damage and have their speed halved for 1 minute. A successful save results in half damage and no movement penalties. The damage increases to 4d8 at the 16th level and 5d8 at the 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 72 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Lagging Thunder (HB)
fields.text:
You unleash a wave of paralyzing energy towards an enemy. A creature within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer 3d10 thunder damage and lose its ability to take a reaction and to make extra attacks, if any, until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage with no additional effects. Damage increases to 4d10 at 16th level and 5d10 at 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Coordinated Strike (HB)
fields.text:
Your attack creates an opening for a coordinated assault. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, up to two allies within 30 feet of you may take a reaction to move up to 10 feet and make a weapon attack against the target.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Draconic Glare (HB)
fields.text:
You unleash a terrifying gaze. Each chosen creature within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 5d6 psychic damage and become frightened for 1 minute. Frightened creatures can attempt the saving throw again at the end of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Life Link (HB)
fields.text:
Gain 3d10 temporary hit points for 1 minute and you may select an ally within 30 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, you suffer any damage taken by that ally instead of it. Your resistances, immunities, or damage reductions do not apply to this transferred damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Stunning Blow (HB)
fields.text:
With a potent blow, you aim to disorient your target. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal its usual damage plus an extra 1d10 bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the start of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Lightning Spirit (HB)
fields.text:
You transform into pure electricity and pass through your foes. Move up to 30 feet in a straight line, without provoking opportunity attacks and able to pass through other creatures. Your path must end in an unoccupied space. You ignore difficult terrain but cannot move through spaces filled by Large or bigger objects. All creatures in your path must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 lightning damage on a failure or half as much damage on a success. If you finish your turn in the air, you fall as normal.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dragonblood Pact (HB)
fields.text:
A massive ethereal dragon rises from the ground and strikes at one of your enemies. The dragon manifests on any solid surface within 90 feet of you and bites a target within 5 feet of it. Make a melee spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 piercing damage and 2d8 energy damage that matches of your Draconic Soul.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Blades of Wind (HB)
fields.text:
Your swift strike slices the air, creating a vacuum that acts as a blade against all in its path. Creatures in a 45-foot long, 5-foot wide line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or suffer 5d10 slashing damage, halving the damage on a successful save. The damage increases to 7d10 at 19th level.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Protecting Mists (HB)
fields.text:
You summon a defensive fog. You gain 4d8 temporary hit points and create a 20-foot-radius cold fog centered on you, lasting for 1 minute. You and any chosen creatures within 30 feet of you can see clearly through the fog; for others, it's heavily obscured. Moderate or stronger wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the fog after three turns. Only one instance of Protecting Mists can be active at a time; activating it again immediately dissipates the previous one.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Thundering Translocation (HB)
fields.text:
You open a rift in space, letting loose thunderous energy. Choose up to two creatures within 30 feet of you; they must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d10 thunder damage. Additionally, you can swap the position of each creature that failed its save with you or another willing creature within 60 feet of you.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 73 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dragon's Breath (HB)
fields.text:
Your dragon lineage allows you to unleash a powerful breath attack based on your Draconic Soul:

Blue Dragon: Lightning erupts in a 90 feet long, 5 feet wide line. Creatures in the line make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

White Dragon: An icy blast fans out in a 60-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 7d8 cold damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

Red Dragon: Fire engulfs a 60-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 74 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Find Weakness (HB)
fields.text:
Your dragonlike perception allows you to exploit your enemies' weaknesses. Up to three creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see must make a Constitution saving throw. Creatures that fail will have their weaknesses revealed to you until the end of their next turn, suffering double damage from your attacks. Also, on a failed save, you learn about any immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities the creature might have.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 74 (Indie)

name: Draconic Power: Heart of the Dragon (HB)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Heart of the Dragon (HB)
fields.text:
Your Draconic Soul confers legendary resilience. You gain 20 temporary hit points and advantage on all saving throws until your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 74 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Spiritual Reprimand (HB)
fields.text:
You manifest an elemental barrier that shields you and up to five allies within 30 feet of you until your next turn. The barrier confers resistance to your Draconic Soul's damage type. When another creature deals damage to you or a shielded ally, the attacking creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it suffers damage and an effect based on your Soul (half damage and no effect on a success).

Red Dragon: The attacker takes 5d6 fire damage and ignites, taking 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns for a minute, or until the flames are doused.

White Dragon: The attacker takes 4d8 cold damage and is restrained until the end of your next turn.

Blue Dragon: The attacker takes 3d10 lightning damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 74 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Flurry of Wings (HB)
fields.text:
You channel draconic energy into spectral wings for you and your allies. You and up to four allies within 30 feet of you sprout spectral wings, gaining a 60 feet flying speed and the ability to make a bonus action melee attack with a 10-foot reach. These attacks deal 3d12 damage of your Draconic Soul's type, using your Intelligence modifier for the attack and damage rolls. If the effect ends and a creature is in the air, it descends gently to the ground.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Ripper Fangs (HB)
fields.text:
Your attack opens the enemy's guard for a follow-up assault. Make a weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage and make two more attacks against the same target. If both extra attacks hit, the target suffers an additional 3d12 damage of the weapon's type.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Sweltering Heat (HB)
fields.text:
Your weapon carries intense heat. Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, deal the usual damage plus 6d6 fire damage. The target must make a Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

name: Draconic Power: Aura of the Scales (HB)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Aura of the Scales (HB)
fields.text:
Your aura shields your allies. You create a 15-foot radius aura around you that lasts until the start of your next turn. When a creature inside this aura takes damage, you can choose to reduce it by 2d6 (minimum to zero).

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Shocking Trap (HB)
fields.text:
You charge the ground with electricity. You affect a 20-foot square area within 60 feet of you until the end of your next turn. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the area take 3d12 lightning damage and must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be restrained until the end of your next turn.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Barrage of Claws (HB)
fields.text:
You unleash a flurry of attacks. Make three weapon attacks against a single target, each dealing an extra 1d6 slashing damage and ignoring the target's damage resistance.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Ghostly Tail (HB)
fields.text:
You execute a spinning energy attack that takes the form of a spectral dragon's tail. Choose any number of creatures within 15 feet. They must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 6d8 damage of the type associated with your Draconic Soul and fall prone. Successful saves result in half damage and no additional effect.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Legendary Resistance (HB)
fields.text:
Drawing upon your Draconic Soul, you can convert a failed saving throw into a successful one. If you've already used a Draconic Power this round, you may opt to suffer one level of exhaustion to ignore the Draconic Power per round limitation.
	After using this power, you cannot use it again until you finish a short rest.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 75 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Frozen Shield (HB)
fields.text:
Shield yourself with a frosty barrier of scales, gaining +3 AC until the end of your next turn. Any creature missing a melee attack against you while this effect is active takes 6d8 cold damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Dimensional Strike (HB)
fields.text:
By manipulating reality with your dragon power, you teleport up to 30 feet and make a weapon attack. This attack deals an extra 3d8 force damage on a hit. You may also teleport up to two allies within 60 feet of you to unoccupied spaces adjacent to your target. Then, each of these allies can make a weapon attack against the target. You must see the place to teleport you and your allies.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Wing Attack (HB)
fields.text:
You emulate a dragon's flight, creating wings that allow you to ascend without provoking attacks of opportunity. All creatures within 15 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The wings dissipate at the end of your next turn, and if it ends while you are still in the air, you descend gently, avoiding damage from falling.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Final Destruction (HB)
fields.text:
Destructive flames fall from the sky, dealing massive destruction to the area. All creatures on a 50-foot-radius sphere centered in a point up to 120 feet of you take 11d6 fire damage. They can halve the damage with a successful Dexterity saving throw.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Ice Fortress (HB)
fields.text:
Project a frigid mist that shields you and your allies. Until the start of your next turn, chosen creatures within 20 feet of you gain resistance to all damage. Enemy creatures entering or starting their turn in the area take 2d8 cold damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Draconic Power: Spatial Storm (HB)
fields.text:
Your power disrupts space itself, opening rifts for your allies to use. Until the end of your next turn, you and any willing creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you can teleport up to 30 feet at the start of their turn. Teleporting in this way charges the creature with energy, adding 4d10 lightning damage to its next attack's damage roll until the duration expires.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 76 (Indie)

fields.name: Ability boost (HB)
fields.text:
Element: Fire

You grant an elemental enhancement to a willing creature within range of the spell, giving it advantage on all ability checks of a single ability of your choice. As a bonus action, if the target is within range of the spell, you can switch the chosen ability or switch the target of the spell to another willing creature, if both are within range of the spell and within 30 feet of each other.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a 3rd-level spell slot or higher, you can choose an additional target for each level above 2nd. When using the bonus action to change the chosen ability, you change the ability bonus for all creatures and you can only use the bonus action to switch a single target at a time.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide and deals 2d6 fire damage plus 1d6 fire damage for each slot level above 2nd.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 92 (Indie)

fields.name: Absorb Spell (HB)
fields.text:
Element: Water

You attempt to disrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell, converting its magical power into healing droplets. If the spell being cast is 5th level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If it is 6th level or higher, you must make a spellcasting ability check. The DC equals 10 plus the level of the spell being cast. On a successful check, the spell fails.
	If the target's spell fails, you can choose to absorb the energy from the interrupted spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level that lasts for 1 minute, or copy it, casting the spell immediately as if you were the original caster, and without requiring any material components.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 45-foot cone and deals 12d6 cold damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 92 (Indie)

fields.name: Accelerate (HB)
fields.text:
Element: Air

You make the winds aid the movements of a willing creature you can see, doubling its speed, and granting a +2 bonus to AC and advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide and deals 2d6 thunder damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 92 (Indie)

fields.name: Adamantine Skin (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (an adamantine piece or item with a minimum value of 1,000 gp)
fields.text:
Element: Earth

The entire surface of your body, including your armor, is covered in adamantine, becoming immune to all damage, except lightning and psychic, for the duration. Additionally, your unarmed and armed melee attacks are considered magical and made of adamantite for the purpose of overcoming resistances or immunities of your enemies.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 45-foot cone and deals 14d6 acid damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 92 (Indie)

fields.name: Adaptive Ear (HB)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Ritual Caster, Elementalist (Tanares), Elementalist (Tanares) (Water)
fields.text:
Element: Water

You magically enhance your hearing by altering the properties of water. For the next hour, you can understand any spoken language or sound-based communication from creatures with an Intelligence of 5 or higher, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) checks related to listening.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge deals cold damage, and on the damage roll, any result of 1 or 2 counts as 3.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 94 (Indie)

fields.name: Air Beneath Your Feet (HB)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Touch Spells, Elementalist (Tanares), Elementalist (Tanares) (Air)
fields.text:
Element: Air

You envelop the legs of a willing creature you touch in wind, and for the duration, the target can jump twice as far as its normal maximum distance and can fall from heights of up to 30 feet without taking any damage from the fall. If falling from greater heights, the target takes damage only for the distance beyond the initial 30 feet.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge deals thunder damage, and on the damage roll, consider every 1 or 2 as a 3.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 94 (Indie)

fields.name: Air Body (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a drop of myrrh essence)

fields.name: Air Double (HB)
fields.text:
Type: Air

You create a gaseous copy of yourself in an empty space beside you. This copy is indistinguishable from you, even by magical means or abilities such as true sight. The copy has the same stats as you, except for its hit points, as the copy disappears and the spell immediately ends if it takes any damage. The copy has its own turn, which can be immediately before or after your turn. You command what it does (actions, bonus actions, reactions, movement, etc.). It has no resources of its own, such as ammunition, ability uses, or spell slots, so every time it uses something that costs a resource, it uses the resources that you have. For example, if the copy casts a spell, it consumes one of your spell slots as though you had cast the spell yourself. The same principle applies to the use of potions, scrolls, and similar items.
	When you are targeted by an attack, spell, or ability that would damage you, you can instantly switch positions with the copy, which must be within 120 feet of you, so it takes the damage and other effects in your place, causing this spell to end automatically. If the damage dealt to the copy comes from a melee attack, the attacker must make a Wisdom saving throw, becoming stunned for 1 minute on a failure. A creature stunned in this way can make the save again at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success. You and your copy cannot be more than 120 feet apart, if that happens the spell ends automatically and the copy disappears.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide and deals 12d6 thunder damage.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 94 (Indie)

fields.name: Air Essence (HB)
fields.text:
Element: Air

You can modify the air near you to create one the following effects:

	• Emulate sounds, from a whisper to a scream, including your voice, someone else's voice, or any other sound. The sound continues throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. A creature can discern the illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

	• Move an object (up to 20 pounds) up to 30 feet through the air.

	• Conceal shallow tracks or footprints by moving dirt around.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 95 (Indie)

fields.name: Ancestral Retraining (HB)
fields.components: V, S, M (a gem worth 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Ritual Caster, Touch Spells, Elementalist (Tanares), Elementalist (Tanares) (Water)
fields.text:
Element: Water

As you cast the spell, the gem used as a material component is consumed to bring visions of the target's ancestors, blending them with the target's memories and unlocking new potential within the individual. However, some of the target's memories are lost in the process. The target may choose to change any or all of their subclass, feats, or features, provided they meet the prerequisites for the chosen options. Certain abilities that require additional resources, such as gold, experience points, or training, cannot be chosen unless the target possesses the necessary resources at the time of casting.
	Once the spell is complete, the chosen options are permanent, and they cannot be altered by this spell or similar effects again. The GM may impose restrictions or penalties to reflect the significant impact of the decision.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge can create a thin layer of water around the creature, granting it 9d6 temporary hit points for 10 minutes.

Source:	Player's Guide to Tanares p. 95 (Indie)

fields.name: Aquatic Form (HB)
fields.classes: School: Evocation, Ritual Caster, Elementalist (Tanares), Elementalist (Tanares) (Water)
fields.text:
Element: Water

You modify the bodies of up to six creatures, allowing them to survive underwater. They can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to their walking speed.

At Higher Levels: When cast as a spell of 4th level or higher, you affect an additional 3 creatures for each level above 3rd.

Elemental Flux: Your next elemental surge affects a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide and deals 5d6 cold damage.
